description: This file defines the 'IntegrationModule' entity class used in the system, representing a configuration for integration modules within the application. It includes fields for module details, configuration settings, audit information, and relationships to other data models.

classes.name: IntegrationModule
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing an integration module configuration, including metadata, configuration settings, and audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key (ID) of the integration module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key (ID) of the integration module.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the module name.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the regions string associated with the module.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the regions string.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration string for the module.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration string.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier for the module.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier.

methods.name: getModuleConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the map of environment-specific module configurations.

methods.name: setModuleConfigs
methods.description: Sets the map of environment-specific module configurations.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image associated with the module.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with the module.

methods.name: isCustomModule
methods.description: Checks if the module is a custom module.

methods.name: setCustomModule
methods.description: Sets whether the module is custom.

methods.name: getConfigDetails
methods.description: Retrieves the detailed configuration string.

methods.name: setConfigDetails
methods.description: Sets the detailed configuration string.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the integration module.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the integration module.
